---- MODULE ivy_examples_ticket ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_ticketDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
AgTypeOK ==
    /\ pc \in [Thread -> {"Idle", "Waiting", "Critical"}]
    /\ service \in Nat
    /\ next_ticket \in Nat
    /\ m \in [Thread -> Nat]

AgInv ==
    /\ AgTypeOK
    /\ service <= next_ticket
    /\ \A t \in Thread : (pc[t] = "Waiting" \/ pc[t] = "Critical") => m[t] < next_ticket
    /\ \A t1, t2 \in Thread : ((pc[t1] = "Waiting" \/ pc[t1] = "Critical") /\ (pc[t2] = "Waiting" \/ pc[t2] = "Critical") /\ t1 # t2) => m[t1] # m[t2]
    /\ \A t \in Thread : pc[t] = "Critical" => m[t] <= service
    /\ \A t \in Thread : (pc[t] = "Waiting" \/ pc[t] = "Critical") => service <= m[t]

AgCover ==
    \A k \in Nat : (service <= k /\ k < next_ticket) => (\E t \in Thread : (pc[t] = "Waiting" \/ pc[t] = "Critical") /\ m[t] = k)

LEMMA AgInit == Init => AgInv
BY Isa, SMTT("r10") DEF Init, AgInv, AgTypeOK

LEMMA AgTake == ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, AgInv, TakeTicket(t) PROVE AgInv'
BY Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF AgInv, AgTypeOK, TakeTicket, vars

LEMMA AgEnter == ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW k \in Nat, AgInv, EnterCritical(t, k) PROVE AgInv'
BY Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF AgInv, AgTypeOK, EnterCritical, vars

LEMMA AgLeave == ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, AgInv, LeaveCritical(t) PROVE AgInv'
BY Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF AgInv, AgTypeOK, LeaveCritical, vars

LEMMA AgStep == ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, AgInv, Step(t) PROVE AgInv'
BY AgTake, AgEnter, AgLeave, Zenon DEF Step

LEMMA AgNext == AgInv /\ [Next]_vars => AgInv'
BY AgStep, Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF Next, Step, AgInv, AgTypeOK, vars, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical

LEMMA AgImpliesME == AgInv => MutualExclusion
BY Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF AgInv, AgTypeOK, MutualExclusion

LEMMA AgCoverInit == Init => AgCover
BY Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF Init, AgCover

LEMMA AgCoverTake == ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, AgInv, AgCover, TakeTicket(t) PROVE AgCover'
BY Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF AgInv, AgTypeOK, AgCover, TakeTicket, vars

LEMMA AgCoverEnter == ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, NEW k \in Nat, AgInv, AgCover, EnterCritical(t, k) PROVE AgCover'
BY Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF AgInv, AgTypeOK, AgCover, EnterCritical, vars

LEMMA AgCoverLeave == ASSUME NEW t \in Thread, AgInv, AgCover, LeaveCritical(t) PROVE AgCover'
BY Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF AgInv, AgTypeOK, AgCover, LeaveCritical, vars

AgPEnter(w, k) == /\ pc[w] = "Waiting"
                  /\ m[w] = k
                  /\ k <= service
                  /\ AgInv
AgQEnter(w) == pc[w] = "Critical"

LEMMA AgB1Enter == ASSUME NEW w \in Thread, NEW k \in Nat PROVE AgPEnter(w, k) /\ [Next]_vars => (AgPEnter(w, k)' \/ AgQEnter(w)')
BY Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF AgPEnter, AgQEnter, AgInv, AgTypeOK, Next, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars

LEMMA AgB2Enter == ASSUME NEW w \in Thread, NEW k \in Nat PROVE AgPEnter(w, k) /\ <<Next /\ Step(w)>>_vars => AgQEnter(w)'
BY Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF AgPEnter, AgQEnter, AgInv, AgTypeOK, Next, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars

LEMMA AgB3Enter == ASSUME NEW w \in Thread, NEW k \in Nat PROVE AgPEnter(w, k) => ENABLED <<Step(w)>>_vars
BY ExpandENABLED, Zenon, Isa, SMTT("r10") DEF AgPEnter, AgQEnter, AgInv, AgTypeOK, Next, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars

AgPLeave(w, s) == /\ pc[w] = "Critical"
                  /\ m[w] = s
                  /\ service = s
                  /\ AgInv
AgQLeave(s) == service = s + 1

LEMMA AgB1Leave == ASSUME NEW w \in Thread, NEW s \in Nat PROVE AgPLeave(w, s) /\ [Next]_vars => (AgPLeave(w, s)' \/ AgQLeave(s)')
BY Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF AgPLeave, AgQLeave, AgInv, AgTypeOK, Next, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars

LEMMA AgB2Leave == ASSUME NEW w \in Thread, NEW s \in Nat PROVE AgPLeave(w, s) /\ <<Next /\ Step(w)>>_vars => AgQLeave(s)'
BY Zenon, SMTT("r10") DEF AgPLeave, AgQLeave, AgInv, AgTypeOK, Next, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars

LEMMA AgB3Leave == ASSUME NEW w \in Thread, NEW s \in Nat PROVE AgPLeave(w, s) => ENABLED <<Step(w)>>_vars
BY ExpandENABLED, Zenon, Isa, SMTT("r10") DEF AgPLeave, AgQLeave, AgInv, AgTypeOK, Next, Step, TakeTicket, EnterCritical, LeaveCritical, vars

LEMMA AgTransLeadsto == ASSUME NEW P, NEW Q, NEW R, P ~> Q, Q ~> R PROVE P ~> R
BY PTL

LEMMA AgReflLeadsto == ASSUME NEW P PROVE P ~> P
BY PTL
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Safety == SafetySpec => []MutualExclusion
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_ticket/ivy_examples_ticket_Safety.tla
<1>1. SafetySpec => []AgInv
  BY AgInit, AgNext, PTL DEF SafetySpec
<1>2. []AgInv => []MutualExclusion
  BY AgImpliesME, PTL
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_ticket/ivy_examples_ticket_Safety.tla

THEOREM Liveness == Spec => NonStarvation
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_ticket/ivy_examples_ticket_Liveness.tla
<1>1. Spec => []AgInv
  BY AgInit, AgNext, PTL DEF Spec, SafetySpec
<1>2. ASSUME NEW w \in Thread, NEW k \in Nat PROVE Spec => (AgPEnter(w, k) ~> AgQEnter(w))
  BY AgB1Enter, AgB2Enter, AgB3Enter, PTL DEF Spec, SafetySpec, AgPEnter, AgQEnter, Next, vars
<1>3. ASSUME NEW w \in Thread, NEW s \in Nat PROVE Spec => (AgPLeave(w, s) ~> AgQLeave(s))
  BY AgB1Leave, AgB2Leave, AgB3Leave, PTL DEF Spec, SafetySpec, AgPLeave, AgQLeave, Next, vars
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, AgTransLeadsto, AgReflLeadsto, PTL DEF Spec, NonStarvation, AgPEnter, AgQEnter, AgPLeave, AgQLeave
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_ticket/ivy_examples_ticket_Liveness.tla
====
